demo.name: brd2603a.demo.bootloader-uart-xmodem-zwave-otw
demo.label: Bootloader - NCP UART XMODEM (OTW for Z-Wave Applications)
demo.model:description: Standalone Bootloader using XMODEM-CRC over UART. The bootloader shows a menu, where an XMODEM transfer can be started by sending ASCII '1', or the application can be started by sending ASCII '2'. This is the recommended UART bootloader for the EmberZNet and Connect protocol stacks. This bootloader was created from the bootloader-uart-xmodem sample. Pay attention to the UART configuration when using a custom board.
